title: Depth two at the boundary of a finite power-series thickening
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with depth A ≥ 2 [def-weil-pbc-depth], let d,n ≥ 0, put B=A[[X_1,...,X_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], I=ker(constantCoeff), Q=B/I^(n+1). Let V be an open of Spec B whose inverse image under the zero section Spec A -> Spec B is Spec A minus its closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For the quotient morphism q:Spec Q -> Spec B, every stalk of Spec Q at a point outside q inverse-image V has depth at least two.

source.place: Tag 0EY9, finite-index punctured thickening calculation; Tag 0337, flat local depth formula.

proof.text: Let k:B -> Q be the quotient map, c:A -> B the constants map, and t:Spec Q -> Spec A the morphism induced by k comp c. Apply truncated_constants_flat and Flat.SpecMap_iff to make t flat.

A prime y of Q contracts to a prime containing I: for b in I, b^(n+1) maps to zero under k, so primality forces b into the contracted prime. Surjectivity of constantCoeff and range_comap_of_surjective give x in Spec A with z x=q y. Composing with constants shows t y=x since constantCoeff comp C is the identity. The condition on V therefore forces t y to be the closed point when y is outside q inverse-image V.

stalkClosedPointIso identifies A with the stalk of Spec A at its closed point. Apply the flat local depth formula to its inverse ring isomorphism, using RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and IsLocalHom.of_surjective; this bounds the base-stalk depth below by depth A. The same formula applied to t.stalkMap y, flat by Flat.stalkMap, bounds the quotient-stalk depth below by that base depth. The fibre-depth terms are nonnegative, so le_self_add gives the two inequalities. MvPowerSeries.isNoetherianRing and quotient Noetherianity supply all Noetherian instances. This also covers d=0 and n=0.

lean.statement:
theorem powerSeries_thickening_boundary_depth
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let Q := FiniteEtale.Adic.base
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n
    let q := FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n
    ∀ y : Q, y ∉ q ⁻¹ᵁ V →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := Q.presheaf.stalk y) (Q.presheaf.stalk y)
